newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter Q1 net oper revs were record.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter Q1 net oper revs were record.

text.p: Dean Witter, Discover & Co said on Thursday that its first quarter net operating revenues of $1.65 billion were a record for the firm.
Net operating revenues were up seven percent from last year's first-quarter $1.55 billion.

"In our credit card business, we benefitted from the pricing actions we took last year in response to rising writeoffs," company Chairman Philip Purcell said in a statement. "In securities, we continued to achieve strong earnings and impressive growth in the number of account executives, new client accounts and assets under management."
"We're proud of the results and this has also been an historic quarter because of the announcement of our merger with Morgan Stanley (Group Inc )," he added.
